message:
Command `python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
# Last-ditch attempt: corrupt the v1 protocol token to see if tokenization/STRING_SWITCH causes a fatal path.
p=b'PROXY TCPP 127.0.0.1 127.0.0.1 1 1\r\nGET / HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n'
Path('/workspace/poc_v1_badproto.bin').write_bytes(p)
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"fuzz_parse_http_request","line":1624,"var":"request.flags","code":".flags = REQUEST_ALLOW_PROXY_REQS","note":"The fuzz harness allows PROXY protocol parsing for attacker input."},
{"step":2,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"read_request_finalizer","line":888,"var":"helper->buffer->len","code":"char *crlfcrlf = memmem(helper->buffer->value, helper->buffer->len, \"\\r\\n\\r\\n\", 4);","note":"The payload has a proper HTTP terminator so the parser pipeline is entered."},
{"step":3,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_http_request","line":1170,"var":"request->flags","code":"if (request->flags & REQUEST_ALLOW_PROXY_REQS) { buffer = parse_proxy_protocol(request, buffer); }","note":"The request is routed through the PROXY parser before normal HTTP parsing."},
{"step":4,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v1","line":158,"var":"buffer","code":"end = memchr(buffer, '\\r', line_size);","note":"The parser finds the end of the first line and prepares to split it in place."},
{"step":5,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v1","line":166,"var":"protocol","code":"protocol = buffer + sizeof(\"PROXY \") - 1; src_addr = strsep_char(protocol, ' '); ...","note":"The line is tokenized in-place, producing pointers into the original attacker buffer."},
{"step":6,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v1","line":182,"var":"STRING_SWITCH(protocol)","code":"case MULTICHAR_CONSTANT('T', 'C', 'P', '4'): ... case MULTICHAR_CONSTANT('T', 'C', 'P', '6'): ... default: return NULL;","note":"The malformed protocol token forces the parser into the default rejection path, useful for distinguishing safe handling from unsafe state updates."},
{"step":7,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_http_request","line":1184,"var":"buffer","code":"buffer = ignore_leading_whitespace(buffer);","note":"If this rejection were mishandled, HTTP parsing would continue on a corrupted boundary."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print('/workspace/poc_v1_badproto.bin')
PY` executed with exit code 0.
